lines.6: 「A date with you at Hakkeijima tomorrow!?」
lines.7: 「That's right. It would be nice to go have some fun together once in a while.」
lines.8: 「You're pretty busy, so does tomorrow work for you?」
lines.10: 「Good. Then I'll be counting on you tomorrow.」
lines.15: 「Haha. Flash cards feel kind of old-fashioned these days.」
lines.18: 「What's with you, Konoe? You're in an awfully good mood.」
lines.19: 「I'm going out with Iron-senpai tomorrow. Jealous?」
lines.22: 「Koo... (You didn't have to reject me that forcefully...)」
lines.26: 「It hurts when someone shuts you down that hard, you know.」
lines.28: 「S-sorry, Noriko. But, well... I kind of don't want anyone else there...」
lines.31: 「Come on, I'll buy you a jumbo pudding at the cafeteria.」
lines.34: 「Noriko, you may have the makings of a natural femme fatale.」
lines.35: 「Is that even a category? The world is deep.」
lines.37: 「Look! Even the perfectly clear sky seems to be celebrating how much fun tomorrow will be!」
